visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short black bob hair, wearing a blue zip-up knit sweater over a white turtleneck and large silver hoop earrings, films herself outdoors. She smiles and talks directly to the camera with a multi-story residential building and the back of a white van in the background. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a mirrored elevator. The woman uses her right hand to press buttons on a circular panel, first hitting '7' and then a lower button while laughing. She holds a large brown paper shopping bag. (3) She stands in a brightly lit hallway in front of a modern door. She points her index finger at a black digital smart lock with a glowing blue Bluetooth logo. The door handle is a vertical silver bar. (4) Upon entering, a white cloud-shaped sign with the text 'mini matters' is visible on the wall behind her. She looks at the camera with an excited, wide-eyed expression. (5) The camera pans to show a spacious, open-plan office with large windows overlooking a city, white desks, black office chairs, and several racks filled with colorful clothing. Several people are seen working at their desks. (6) She opens a glass door to enter a meeting room where a group of women are seated around a long wooden table. They wave and smile enthusiastically at the camera. (7) A man in a bright orange hoodie walks through a minimalist room with a long wooden table and chairs, leading the woman into a second partitioned area where another woman is working on a laptop. (8) She enters a photography studio area featuring a large ring light on a tripod, stacks of storage boxes, and various production equipment against white walls. She looks shocked and delighted. (9) Finally, she stands next to the man in the orange hoodie in a clean, white-walled room, both looking at the camera as she finishes speaking.

(2) A sharp 'ding' sound effects occurs, marking an elevator arrival, followed by the metallic click of button presses and a giggle from the speaker. (3) Electronic 'beeps' and a mechanical latch click sound as a smart lock is operated. The BGM remains upbeat. (4) A 'whoosh' transition sound effects leads into the indoor office environment. The main voice continues with high arousal and positive valence. (5) A sudden burst of high-arousal cheering and laughter from several women overlaps the main speech and BGM as a greeting occurs. (6) Sounds of glass doors sliding and light footsteps occur. The speaker's voice maintains a narrative tone with frequent rising intonations. (7) A 'pop' bubble sound effects occurs to emphasize a visual surprise. (8) A brief male voice with a calm, neutral tone responds to the speaker. The BGM fades out with a final melodic 'ding' or bell chime.
